note: The owner's decision of 2026-09-28: the accounting analyst works seven areas in this order and an industry lens, and writes a finding or 'nothing found, and why' for each; the financial analyst files its pressure anomalies under the areas listed for it. An anomaly id starts with its area. docs/CHECKLIST.md carries the same lists with each indicator's source and who computes it. Added beside areas.json, which is not changed: rules/ is append-only.

cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.receivables_factoring_lifting_cash: proceeds from the sale of receivables (calculator terms.trailing_four_quarters.proceeds_from_sale_of_receivables) or a factoring programme in the notes, lifting operating cash flow
cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.supplier_finance_lifting_cash: a supplier or supply-chain finance obligation (calculator terms.balances_now.supplier_finance_obligation) rising while payables days rise
cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.cash_flow_classification_shift: an item moving between operating and investing cash flows, or a new line in either, the notes explain or do not
cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.purchase_obligations_growing: unconditional purchase obligations (calculator terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations) growing faster than cost of revenue
cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.guarantees_and_variable_interest_entitie: guarantees (calculator terms.balances_now.guarantee_maximum_exposure), variable-interest entities or other off-balance-sheet arrangements added or widened
cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.share_based_compensation_as_cost: share-based compensation large against free cash flow (calculator free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted), treated as the real cost it is

industry_lens.inventory_obsolescence: inventory days rising, inventory write-downs (calculator terms.trailing_four_quarters.inventory_write_down) or reserve language changing
industry_lens.purchase_commitment_excess: purchase commitments or prepaid supply agreements beyond what the revenue outlook absorbs
industry_lens.customer_concentration: a customer's share of revenue or receivables rising (calculator concentration.facts, each a fact id with its axes)
industry_lens.channel_stuffing: sell-in outrunning sell-through: receivables and distributor inventory rising faster than revenue, or end-of-quarter shipments
industry_lens.circular_or_vendor_financed_deals: the company investing in, lending to or guaranteeing a customer that then buys from it
